readme:
# TikTok Broadcast Room Information API

Look up details and stream data for a specific room using its `room_id`. This endpoint provides metadata for TikTok broadcasts.

## Use cases

- Retrieve operational information for an active broadcast room.
- Monitor stream statistics using the designated room identifier.
- Verify current status and stream attributes for TikTok broadcasts.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/tiktok/app-v3/live-room-info" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"room_id": "7385461256746060575"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `room_id` | string | Yes | Live room id |

## Notes

- Provide the target stream identifier via `room_id`.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [TikTok LIVE Status](/model/tiktok/app-v3/check-live-room-online): Check whether a TikTok LIVE room is currently live by room ID.
- [TikTok Room Online Status Batch](/model/tiktok/app-v3/check-live-room-online-batch): Returns the online availability status for multiple TikTok broadcast rooms in a single request.
- [TikTok Content Translation](/model/tiktok/app-v3/content-translate): Translates provided text content into a designated target language.
